name: Sun
source:
A strange cat that appeared before the protagonist all of a sudden. Whether it ended up being transported to this world like the protagonist or was deliberately following her, she encounters it several times throughout the story. It has a capricious personality and it tends to disappear as soon as it shows up.

‘...Nya~?’

[Translated from [url=https://twitter.com/mekakare_love]the official Twitter[/url].]
